pending_collisions.evidence: ggml will exist three times once Diffuse is acquired: llama.cpp (LLM, ggml-org upstream), whisper.cpp (Diffuse, ggml-org upstream), and stable-diffusion.cpp (Diffuse, leejet/ggml - a PERSONAL FORK). Two upstreams, three copies. Recorded before acquiring, per A3.
pending_collisions.resolution_2026_09_13: libggml is built once from canonical ggml-org/ggml at the commit the pinned llama.cpp syncs (scripts/sync-ggml.last); the vendored llama.cpp/ggml/ was proven byte-identical to it, so llama.cpp consumes libggml via LLAMA_USE_SYSTEM_GGML=ON - one ggml copy for LLM. whisper.cpp and stable-diffusion.cpp (Diffuse, not yet acquired) carry their OWN sync commits/fork; when Diffuse is acquired each must be checked against this tree and either match it or be recorded as a second, distinct ggml identity. The cross-runtime collision is therefore narrowed, not closed.
